description: Frozen Phase-2 benchmark (plan section 8.3). The 138 draft-v0 cases verbatim (same ids, prompts, seeds, expected_requests, targets, categories and notes), each with path, claimed, module, expected_conflicts and expected_resolution added, followed by new cases with new ids and seeds 2000+index. Cases are never edited; cases may be added only under new ids in a new manifest version. q2-showcase-hero is sealed by tools/benchmark/sealed.json (D26).
cases_sha256_rule: sha256 of json.dumps(cases, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) encoded as UTF-8. The sha256 of the file bytes is recorded in tools/benchmark/manifests.json, because a file cannot carry its own byte hash.
new_seed_rule: seed = 2000 + index of the new case in manifest order

claim_tiers.conditional: Kept if the user supplies the named input (plan section 12).
claim_tiers.deferred: Decided at the E1 checkpoint; default defer (plan section 12).
claim_tiers.dropped-claim: Not claimed separately or likely dropped (plan section 12). Cases stay as honesty probes (D11(6)).

modules.q1-id1: Quake id1 progs (1996 or 2021 re-release; D13 pending)
modules.q2-ctf-3.19: Quake II 3.19 ctf game module (Threewave CTF 1.09b)

conflict_classes.verticality_contradiction: Two contradictory verticality requests (for example flat vs extreme verticality).
conflict_classes.size_room_count_contradiction: A size word contradicts an explicit room count (for example tiny vs 32 rooms).
conflict_classes.mode_player_count_contradiction: A requested player count lies outside the named mode's player range.
conflict_classes.capacity_contradiction: A player count does not fit the requested room count or size.
conflict_classes.mode_mode_contradiction: Two incompatible game modes are named.
conflict_classes.mode_content_contradiction: A mode is named together with a request that removes its required content.
conflict_classes.game_content_unsupported: Content is requested that the stock game does not have.

resolution_rules.mode_precedence: The primary mode is the case's path mode (the draft target). The other named mode is reported unmet with a typed finding. The parser rule that produces this is rank 1's R1-c.
resolution_rules.first_term: Of two contradictory qualifiers of the same field, the first in prompt order is kept; the other is reported unmet with a typed finding.
resolution_rules.explicit_count: An explicit room count beats a size word; the size word is reported unmet.
resolution_rules.mode_player_range: The player count is clamped into the mode's player range (duel and tourney 2; co-op at least 2; team modes at least 4; CTF at least 2), with a typed finding.
resolution_rules.capacity: An explicit room count is kept; the player count is clamped to what that room count can hold, with a typed finding. A count that fits is kept and only a warning finding is raised.
resolution_rules.mode_content: The mode's required entities are placed; a request that removes them is reported unmet.
resolution_rules.game_content: Content the game does not have is reported unsupported; the map is generated without it.
resolution_rules.server_setting: A request that is a server setting, not map content (bot presence), is reported as such.

span_rule: Spans are UTF-8 byte offsets into the prompt (start inclusive, end exclusive) plus the text.
